TFDAppointment.title: TFD Appointment
TFDAppointment.description: A request for Tratamento Fora de Domicílio transportation.

userId.description: The ID of the user who requested the transport.

userName.description: The name of the user who requested the transport.

appointmentDate.description: The date and time of the medical appointment.

transportDate.description: The requested date and time for transport.

medicalSpecialty.description: The medical specialty of the appointment.

hasAccompanyingPerson.description: Whether the patient has an accompanying person.

accompanyingPersonName.description: The name of the accompanying person, if any.

status.description: The current status of the request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.
